findings.passage: State Rep. David Abbott (R-Rome City) said to register, Indiana residents must be at least 18 years old on or before the upcoming election, have a valid Indiana Driver's License or Indiana State Identification Card, be a citizen of the United States, have lived in the same precinct for at least 30 days before the next election, and not currently imprisoned after being convicted of a crime.
findings.note: In a caucus press release issued for several legislators, Abbott described the existing Indiana registration requirements, including a driver's license or state ID card and U.S. citizenship. He describes current rules and does not say whether they should change.

subjects: proof of citizenship to register or vote
